I have just copied across my wordpress site to a new host and need to change the URL used for the site. Does anyone know if there is an easy way to do this?
I could really do with some help re: changing my site address for wordpress.

I am not sure the reason you need to change the URL, but Wordpress does allow you to do this very easily by adding a couple of lines of code to your wp-config.php file.

Just add:

define('WP_HOME','http://example.com');
define('WP_SITEURL','http://example.com');

Obviously changing the URL to the new URL you wish to use.

A Realistic Comparison: NAFTA vs The TPP

Another good comparison is the Korea-US Free Trade Agreement that went into effect in 2011. It had the same inflated claims made about it as the TPP, but the reality is that the US trade deficit with South Korea has nearly doubled since 2011, resulting in an estimated 75,000 US jobs lost between 2011 and 2014.

Of course, that's just the "free trade" part. The other worrisome thing about TPP is the “Investor-State Dispute Settlement” tribunals it would set up, which would issue legally binding decisions in signatory countries. These tribunals would allow corporations to sue governments whose laws undermine their interests, for example if a country decides that it won't enforce DRM with laws like the DMCA.

It's a bad deal all around.

The opportunity for those tribunals is particularly unsettling. Really, any talk of 'free trade' is going to screw workers but the rapid acquisition of rights by corporations (and I suppose corporate personhood in general) is jarring.
